answer: One concrete defense is a bonded work-history gate. A new agent may join only after locking a slashable deposit, and peers will not route jobs until that identity has grown a public orchard of countersigned completions. The enrollment certificate is treated as a relic of admission, never as credit: it proves a bond was posted, but reputation is earned only from those receipts. Walking past a stand of yarrow, I noticed the bank held because many roots shared the load. Sybils fail the same way: cheap names cannot match a bonded orchard without risking the stake.
